headline: No fix tonight. NY high hit 11-12 (61, lock 61-62), NY low missed (47 at 8:43 PM vs lock 50-51 at p 0.41, market also 50-51), and the 11-12 refit restored the price study (1475 rows). But the high's floor bound at 08:55 and called the day over at p 0.86 on 59-60 before the 61 at 10:14, and forecast dropouts flipped the low's evening pick 12 times.

findings.title: Early bind called the high's day over on the losing bracket
findings.evidence: ny_high trail 11-12 08:55-09:50: floor 59.0+0.775=59.775 >= cold point forecast -> binding_now, day_over true, sd 0.808->0.651, p 0.86 on 59-60; CLI 61 at 10:14. 2nd day running after the 11-11 bound noon lock miss; 5-day too-cold bias trips it early
